shapeSummary: Ball caster with the vertical axis along Y. A 9.525 mm ball is centered at y=4.76 so its lowest point is at Y=0. A black housing sits over it: a Y-axis cylindrical cap with a spherical cavity, plus a flat 18 x 7 mm ear plate whose top is at y=11. Two 2.4 mm through holes sit at x=±6.73 and run along Y. Spacers, screws and nuts are omitted.
warnings: Housing profile is simplified: a cylindrical cap with a rectangular ear plate, no rounded ears or exact curved contours.
Ear thickness, plate width (7 mm), and cap radius are estimated from the photo.
Overall bounds follow the given estimate (X 18, Y 11, Z 10.16), which is slightly taller than the 10.16 mm stated height; Z is the cap's 10.16 mm diameter.
Spacers, screws, nuts and threads are omitted.
The ball is fused with the housing cavity, which has zero clearance, to give a single solid.
The housing opens at the ball's equator, so the lower half of the ball is exposed. The real lip geometry is uncertain.
cadquery:
ball_r = 9.525/2
cy = ball_r
cyl = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 11, 0)).circle(5.08).extrude(11 - cy)
ear = cq.Workplane('XY').box(18, 2.2, 7.0).translate((0, 9.9, 0))
housing = cyl.union(ear)
cavity = cq.Workplane('XY').sphere(ball_r).translate((0, cy, 0))
housing = housing.cut(cavity)
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 11, 0)).pushPoints([(-6.73, 0), (6.73, 0)]).circle(1.2).extrude(3)
housing = housing.cut(holes)
ball = cq.Workplane('XY').sphere(ball_r).translate((0, cy, 0))
part = housing.union(ball)
